title: 6 - Music Row Modern - The Music City Collection
description:
LOCATION At this centrally located gem, attractions like the Johnny Cash Museum, the Country Music Hall of Fame, and the Ryman Auditorium are all just about a mile away, and in-between is your pick of cafes, craft breweries, local bars and music venues.  Enjoy the city views from the private rooftop.  There is plenty of room to hang out and enjoy the Nashville Skies with a cozy fireplace.  

STR Permit #2022072633

The space
There is a two car garage and driveway with free street parking surrounding the house.  The first level of the home consists of the two car garage and two king Bedrooms that share a jack and jill bath.  The second level boasts an open floor plan living area, dining room, kitchen, half bath, and third bedroom with king bed and full ensuite bath.  The primary bedroom suite with king bed and large bath is located on the third level with the bonus room, another half bath,  and the rooftop terrace!  The terrace has plenty of room to hang out and enjoy the Nashville Skies with a cozy fireplace.

Credit Card Processing Fees are non-refundable.

Your host is available by message or text throughout your stay. 

General Inquiries are answered  M-F 8am-5pm CST during business hours. 
Emergency Calls after 9pm CST: Please call Twice in a Row from the same number to bypass Do Not Disturb Settings.  Emergencies include Lockout, Busted Pipes, or other Major Issue.  For Fire/Police/Medical Emergency call 911 first.

Guest access
Guests have access to the entire house.
